sources.title: Erasure code
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: OpenZFS scrub：校驗發現與可修復副本矩陣
related.titleEn: OpenZFS scrub: detecting corruption and identifying repairable copies
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩策略帳本、單位核算、漏算讀取反例與 backend 適用性說明；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver both strategy ledgers, unit checks, the omitted-read counterexample and backend applicability notes. Label all amplification results as consequences of the declared educational strategy. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 每列為 block_id、expected_digest、copyA、copyB、backup_digest；先判斷每份是否可信，再判斷邏輯區塊。
related.differenceEn: Record block identity, expected digest, both copies and any backup digest. Validate individual copies first, then classify logical blocks as healthy, repairable or unrecoverable.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 模型選擇 k=4、m=2，每 shard 1 MiB；小更新先讀四資料 shard 再寫六 shard，放大量為總模型 I/O 除有用更新量；名義只改 64 KiB，完整讀 4 MiB 寫 6 MiB；變更提供完整 4 MiB 新條帶，只寫 6 MiB；名義式 (4+6)*1024/64 = 160 modeled I/O amplification；變更式 6/4 = 1.5 modeled I/O amplification。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

教學雙副本模型中，至少有一份通過預期 checksum 的區塊才可恢復；可恢復比例為合格區塊數除總數；一百個邏輯區塊，其中三個只有一份壞、兩個兩份皆壞，其餘正常；變更用已驗證備份修復那兩個區塊；名義式 (100-2)/100*100 = 98 % recoverable blocks；變更式 100/100*100 = 100 % recoverable blocks。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Choose k=4, m=2 and 1 MiB shards. The specified small-update strategy reads four data shards and writes six shards; amplification divides modeled read-plus-write bytes by useful update bytes. Nominally update 64 KiB while reading 4 MiB and writing 6 MiB. In the changed case provide the full new 4 MiB stripe and write 6 MiB without reading old data. Nominal (4+6)*1024/64 = 160 modeled I/O amplification; changed 6/4 = 1.5 modeled I/O amplification. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

In the two-copy fixture, a block is recoverable only if at least one copy matches its expected checksum. Recoverable fraction divides qualifying logical blocks by total blocks, not good replicas by replica count. Use one hundred logical blocks: three have one bad copy, two have both copies bad and the rest are healthy. Restore the two unrecoverable blocks from a separately verified backup in the changed fixture. Nominal (100-2)/100*100 = 98 % recoverable blocks; changed 100/100*100 = 100 % recoverable blocks. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 雙路供電：共同祖先與最小切集
related.titleEn: Dual power paths: common ancestors and minimal cut sets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩策略帳本、單位核算、漏算讀取反例與 backend 適用性說明；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。

Label all amplification results as consequences of the declared educational strategy. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立 source、UPS、PDU、load 有向圖，每負載列出 A/B 路徑；標記共同祖先而非僅著色兩條線。
related.differenceEn: Build a directed source, UPS, PDU and load graph with explicit A/B paths. Identify common ancestors instead of simply drawing the two paths in different colors.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 模型選擇 k=4、m=2，每 shard 1 MiB；小更新先讀四資料 shard 再寫六 shard，放大量為總模型 I/O 除有用更新量；名義只改 64 KiB，完整讀 4 MiB 寫 6 MiB；變更提供完整 4 MiB 新條帶，只寫 6 MiB；名義式 (4+6)*1024/64 = 160 modeled I/O amplification；變更式 6/4 = 1.5 modeled I/O amplification。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

每負載至少一條完整來源路徑存活才可用；移除指定元件後，以圖可達性計算無路徑負載數；十六負載名義的兩路都依賴 UPS-X；變更後八負載改具獨立 Y 路徑，其餘八仍只依賴 X；事件為 X 失效；名義式 8+8 = 16 loads disconnected；變更式 16-8 = 8 loads disconnected。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Choose k=4, m=2 and 1 MiB shards. The specified small-update strategy reads four data shards and writes six shards; amplification divides modeled read-plus-write bytes by useful update bytes. Nominally update 64 KiB while reading 4 MiB and writing 6 MiB. In the changed case provide the full new 4 MiB stripe and write 6 MiB without reading old data. Nominal (4+6)*1024/64 = 160 modeled I/O amplification; changed 6/4 = 1.5 modeled I/O amplification. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

A load remains available only if at least one complete source path survives. Remove the specified component and use reachability to count disconnected loads, rather than counting plugs or cables. All sixteen loads initially depend on UPS-X through both apparent paths. After changing the graph, eight gain an independent path through Y while eight still depend only on X. The event removes X. Nominal 8+8 = 16 loads disconnected; changed 16-8 = 8 loads disconnected. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
